text_block_list.text: One day, after finishing the Kikuka-sho and continuing our training for the Tenno Sho (Spring).

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
*pant, pant*...!
*pant, pant*...!

Her lap times, usually so precise,
were inexplicably thrown off.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...Ngh, no problem. 
As soon as I recover, I will proceed to the next training session.

—However, her condition didn't improve after that either...
We wrapped up training early for the day.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...Error 'unrest' confirmed.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Errors occurring irregularly since the Kikuka Sho.
Tendency to increase during automated replay of Kikuka Sho memories.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Analysis result: cause unknown.
......

Mihono Bourbon wore a solemn expression.
As she stood there—

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Um... Bourbon-san?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"Flower-san. Good evening.
Is something the matter?"

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
Forgive me if I'm being meddlesome.
Um... are you feeling unwell?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
No, it's quite good.
Why do you ask?

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
From what I can tell, anyway. Lately,
Bourbon-san seems kind of spaced out, or something.

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text: Even in the cafeteria, she usually eats plenty, but lately it feels like she hasn't, so I've been worried.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Referencing data log. Indeed, this week's average
food intake has decreased by 20% compared to before.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"However, body temperature is normal, no pain detected.
Condition is good. No issues."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: In other words... "Thank you for your concern."

text_block_list.name: Nishino Flower
text_block_list.text:
No, if that's the case, then it's fine, but...
Um, please don't push yourself too hard, okay?
The day after that happened—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(—12.33 seconds, passed 200m.
Operation: Keep the tempo.)

As if yesterday's run had never happened,
Mihono Bourbon was clocking times smoothly and precisely as usual, but—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Haah, haah...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (—"Unrest" stirs deep within my chest.)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: —Today, Rice is going to win...!

With 1,000 meters to the finish, she suddenly accelerated
and crossed the line with a ridiculous lap time.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: *pant, pant, pant*...!

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
“...Error occurred.
Encountered an unexplained state of confusion while running.”

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Temporarily reached the threshold of physical fatigue.
However, this will not impede training.

No matter how you looked at it, they didn't seem fine at all.
When I took them to the nurse's office—

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text:
Indeed, there seems to be nothing wrong with your body.
No signs of lack of sleep, poor nutrition, or anemia either.

text_block_list.name: School Nurse
text_block_list.text: "Perhaps it's a mental thing. It would probably be best to take a little break."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: "However, daily adjustments are absolutely essential as we head toward the Tenno Sho (Spring)."
choice_data_list: I understand how you feel, but let's take a little rest.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...
Order received.

And so, we hastily decided to take
a few days off.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The chirping of little birds...
The gentle ripples on the river's surface...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
......
Status: "Bored" confirmed.

Mihono Bourbon stared blankly at the water's surface.
Just then——
(Dadadadaah!)

There was a small shadow running with incredible speed
across the riverbed.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"*pant, pant, pant, pant*!
—O-One more lap...!"
(Splat!)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
...!
Rice Shower has fallen. Send medical staff immediately—

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Guh...!

However, Rice Shower immediately
leaped to her feet and began running again.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(...Spotted a pair of old, discarded shoes by the side of the path.
Judging by the color and shape, they belong to Rice.)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Taaaahhh!!
For the next several hours, Mihono Bourbon continued to watch Rice Shower's self-training.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Phew...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Are you all right, Rice-san? It looked like you bumped your knee when you fell earlier.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Wait, Bourbon-san...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, you're right...!
There's a little bit of blood...

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
It's just a small scratch, but don't let your guard down.
Let's wash it and put on a bandage.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
—Treatment complete. Keep the area moisturized
and be sure to change the bandage regularly.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Th-Thank you...

Having put away the equipment, Mihono Bourbon
stared intently at Rice Shower's face.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: ...It was a little "unexpected."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
The 'you' stored in my logs is not of the "disposition"
to instantly scramble back to your feet after taking a fall.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah... So you saw me...
That was... um...
Rice Shower looked up into Mihono Bourbon's face, as if she had made up her mind.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I wanted to do my best in the Tenno Sho (Spring)... It's all t-thanks to Bourbon-san.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Who, me?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...Ever since I got to run all out with Bourbon-san in the 'Kikuka Sho',
my heart hasn't stopped... pounding with excitement."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Whenever I remember that day, my heart starts pounding and fluttering, and I just can't help myself...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"I'm just completely overwhelmed
by this feeling of wanting to win—of desperately needing to win...!"

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
"...And then, you know, the timid Rice
retreats just a little bit."

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice thought that maybe...
she could try even harder too.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Maybe I can get 1st place in the Tenno Sho (Spring)...
No, I want to WIN it...!

Mihono Bourbon gazes intently
at Rice Shower's face as she speaks.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Ah, smells nice...
I wonder if today's meal is carrot curry?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: (――Rice-san's "heart thumps" also tend to happen frequently during automatic replays of her "Kikka-sho" memories.)

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
(And Rice-san testified that it corresponds to "wanting to win."
Which means—)

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
Bourbon...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Rice-san. Well then, I shall take my leave here.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Huh.
W-What's wrong...?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: A matter requiring a report to Master has arisen.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: Master, I... "want to win."

Mihono Bourbon burst into the Trainer's office
and blurted that out the second she opened her mouth.
choice_data_list: What's wrong, all of a sudden?
What's wrong, all of a sudden?

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: —Audio data, playback.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I'm filled with this overwhelming feeling
of wanting to win more, absolutely wanting to win...!"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I'll take this one, too.
Basically, she wasn't the type to burn with a desire to win. And yet—

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Just like how I vied with Rice-san at the Kikuka Sho,
I want to clash with someone and "win."

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
"I want to do it as much as possible.
I want to feel that 'passion' from back then once more――"

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text: I do have such a desire...!

As Mihono Bourbon spoke, she sparkled
more brilliantly than I had ever seen before.
She seems like a completely different person compared to three days ago when she was out of shape.

text_block_list.name: Mihono Bourbon
text_block_list.text:
Therefore, Master.
I will win the Tenno Sho (Spring).
With those words, Mihono Bourbon gave a happy smile.
